changes: Merch Tokens drop after every wave and buy cards, relics, removal, and healing at the between-wave shop.
Cut and Rest are no longer free; deck thinning and resting are economic decisions.
Run saves reset to v5 while profile stats and art progress carry over.
Death log shows final moments on defeat and in the tour receipt.
Member voice lines call out combos, finales, victory, and defeat.
Member keyword identities with eight Pierce, Drain, Charm, and Encore cards.
Three persistent mid-run tour events with relic, curse, upgrade, and removal tradeoffs.
Tour routing no longer offers relic stops when no relics remain and falls back instead of locking.
Stale tour routes are refreshed on reload and sold-out picks reroute.
Leona's tour routing now offers three stops after every wave.
Attack cards preview effective damage with lethal and spotlight markers.
Bosses can burn cards, drain Hype Energy, and reflect the first attack.
Validated the new routing and energy-penalty save fields.
Buff card upgrades now state their cost reduction, so Zhonya's Hourglass and Ionian Boots no longer preview as unchanged.
Encore tiers now unlock exactly one level per non-daily full clear.
Daily World Tour wins no longer advance Encore progression.
Removed the profile load rule that re-derived Encore unlocks from total leader wins.
Added a three-slot buff zone with timed and one-shot stage-gear buffs.
Added six Data Dragon item buffs plus Kai'Sa's Encore Overflow hand-size card.
Buff cards prompt to replace an existing buff when all three slots are full.
Timed buffs count down and expire when a wave ends; one-shots persist until they fire.
Rebuilt the Tailwind stylesheet.
Added a member combo reference to the combat screen and How to Play.
Interrupt thresholds now show a live STUN meter and name HP damage explicitly.
Interrupted boss intents log a fizzle instead of claiming to execute.
Added a pin toggle to keep one card for the next turn; it costs a draw slot.
Hand size can temporarily exceed five, and Killer Instinct now opens three extra slots.
Moved career statistics and the Kaiju Codex into Options and removed the separate Codex/Changelog menu.
Loaded validated default keyboard bindings from assets/keybinds.json while keeping custom bindings in profile data.
Preserved profile v3 progress and run v4 save compatibility.
Updated developer documentation and rebuilt the static Tailwind stylesheet.
Added How to Play and Options modals with persistent sound and configurable keyboard shortcuts.
Normalized settings for existing profile v3 saves without resetting progress; muting now silences active synthesized tones.
Extracted progression screens and shared changelog rendering into focused UI modules.
Updated developer documentation and rebuilt the committed Tailwind stylesheet.
Restricted signature starter Relics to their leader and removed them from random Relic rewards.
Capped the hand at five cards and normalized oversized saved hands without losing cards.
Advanced ranked art borders only for the leader whose run cleared the wave.
Replaced the Tailwind Play CDN with a prebuilt stylesheet for GitHub Pages.
Reset previous run saves and profile progress so all players begin a fresh tour.
Completed the World Tour hub with art and Codex progress, version history, daily challenges, and daily win streak tracking.
Added deterministic UTC-seeded Daily World Tours with assigned leaders, optional starter Relics, and Acoustic Set, Encore Pressure, or Crowd Surf rules.
Added retained cards, post-battle deck thinning for +10 HP, and copyable victory/defeat Tour Receipts.
Aligned stage hazards with the expansion plan and normalized Daily Tour and receipt metrics in existing v3 run saves.
Fixed relic data validation to accept the four leader starter relic effect types, preventing the game from failing to load.
Updated developer documentation for Encore, starter relic, hazard, and battle-log behavior.
Updated EMP Static and Stage Fright to remain in hand until played or exhausted, and corrected Micro-Oxygen to cost 1 Hype Energy while retaining its end-turn damage effect.
Made the battle log collapsible and default it to collapsed on small screens.
Updated developer documentation for Encore Ascension, starter relics, hazard cards, and battle-log behavior.
Updated hazard Status cards so EMP Static and Stage Fright remain in hand until spent, and tuned Micro-Oxygen to a 1-cost end-turn hazard.
Added sequential Encore Ascension tiers 1–5 with boss HP, healing, Strength, curse, interrupt, and Phase 2 modifiers.
Added signature starter relics for Ahri, Akali, Evelynn, and Kai'Sa.
Added synthesized boss enrage and dorsal interrupt audio cues.
Preserved v3 run saves and existing profile data while adding Encore progression.
Added reactive passives, Strength scaling, and one-time enrage phases for Waves 4–10.
Added EMP Static and Micro-Oxygen Status cards, boss Status injection, and charged-attack interrupts.
Added boss passive and Strength indicators while preserving existing run saves.
Added four selectable leaders with one-use-per-run special abilities.
Added leader-specific POP/STARS, MORE, and FIRESTARTER art progression with ranked borders.
Reset existing run and profile saves for the new progression system.
Limited the changelog dropdown to four visible releases with scrolling for older entries.
Added Male MUTO and Female MUTO encounters to the kaiju setlist.
Moved Burning Godzilla to Wave 10 and added distinct MUTO artwork and release notes.
Connected browser cache reset behavior to app version changes.
Added version-bound cache-busting for JSON assets.
Fixed stale changelog data by disabling browser caching for JSON asset loads.
Fixed the version dropdown layering behind the enemy block.
Fixed the version dropdown layering behind the enemy block.
Unspent Holo Shield now carries over into the next player turn.
Added a version badge and changelog dropdown to the header.
